metadata.title: New Wave Portrait with High-Contrast Warm Lighting

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a male figure with textured, spiky blonde hair, set against a split background of dark shadow and intense yellow light. The lighting creates a strong chiaroscuro effect on the face, while a soft-edged silhouette of a plant or object is projected onto the bright yellow background section.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face illuminated by the same warm yellow as the background right-side.
Dark, structured blazer contrasting against the glowing yellow backdrop.
Typography placed at the top margin, bridging the dark and light zones.
coreInvariants: Spiky, voluminous blonde hair with feathered texture.
A sharp vertical divide between the dark left background and the bright yellow right background.
A soft, out-of-focus shadow cast on the yellow wall.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright yellow vertical band on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move up to the stylized text, and then follow the shadow on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space on the left and bright space on the right, framing the central figure.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale Skin Tones and White Shirt
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow channel; high value contrast between the black suit and the glowing background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial capitals with decorative flourishes
Interlocking or tightly kerned letter pairs

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space above the subject's head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two contrasting colors to match the background split.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the historical, calligraphic weight and terminal style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with 1980s spiky blonde hair wearing a black blazer and white shirt. The background is split vertically: the left side is dark and shadowy, the right side is a glowing, vibrant yellow wall with a soft, blurry shadow of a plant cast upon it. The lighting on the man's face should be warm and directional from the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply Uncial-style text at the top. The text on the left (dark side) should be bright yellow. The text on the right (yellow side) should be black. Ensure the text is large and decorative.

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture spiky and voluminous?
Is the background split clearly between dark and yellow?
Does the typography use a Celtic or Uncial influence?
Is the shadow on the yellow wall soft and out of focus?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Balanced typographic layout across the color split

postGenerationChecks: Check for the vertical color split in the background.
Verify the presence of the soft-focus shadow on the right.
Ensure the typography color flips to maintain legibility against the background.
Confirm the subject's hair has a distinct 80s textured style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast split-background studio portrait with color-inverted Uncial typography for a retro-modern music aesthetic.
